Name: Coop and Barn Facelift (Content Patcher)
Author: nykachu
Description:
It doesn't make sense to me that Robin would build you a brand new home for your animals and it's already run down and full of random piles of wood and such.
This cleans it up to looking fresh and new, and does some other tweaks to distinguish it from other mods that clean up the coop/barn.

[b][u]Wood options[/u][/b]:
"Vanilla", "TD"
[i](Vanilla - closest to base game color, TD - Dark wood to match A Toned Down Stardew Valley interior mod)[/i]

[color=#f4f4f4][b][u]Wall Color Options[/u][/b]:
vanilla, red, orange, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, pastelpink, cream, chocolate,
tdred, tdblue, tdgreen, tdpurple, tdwhite, tdgold, tdrosegold, tdchocolate
[/color][i](Vanilla - closest to base game color. td colors are slightly desaturated and look better with the TD wood option)[/i]

I may add more wall colors and possibly floor colors in the future, please let me know if there is something you'd like to see with this mod : )

This is my first posted mod so please let me know kindly if there are any mistakes.

[u][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/u]:
Ensure first that you have SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Download and unzip and place the folder into your stardew valley \ mods folder
inside the folder you can change the config file to select which color you want the walls.

[b][u]Un-install Instructions[/u][/b]:
Simply remove the [CP] Coop and Barn Facelift folder from you Mods folder
[color=#00ffff]Make sure nothing (chests, machines, furniture etc.) is against the bottom or right walls [b]before[/b] you do remove it though, since that could cause them to become inaccessible (this mod expands the interiors slightly by one tile right and down). - if you're using the retexture only version you can ignore this[/color]
